Private swimming pools shall comply with the requirements for safety and accessibility as provided in Section 3109.3 and this section.
   Exception: An above-ground private swimming pool which has a maximum water depth of 4 feet (1219 mm) and an area not exceeding 500 square feet (46.45 m 2 ) that is accessory to an R-3 occupancy and is privately used for noncommercial purposes shall not be required to comply with Sections 3109.3.1, 3109.3.2, 3109.5.2, 3109.5.3 and 3109.5.4.
(Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2023/077.
